title: Storm Sorceress Over Ships
description: A female sorceress with purple braided hair, horns, and ornate armor floats above a turbulent stormy sea, wielding a glowing blue staff in one hand and casting a swirling vortex of wind and water with the other. Below her, two wooden sailing ships are tossed violently by massive crashing waves under a dark sky filled with lightning, aurora lights, and a ghostly white spectral figure.
prompt: A powerful female sorceress with long purple braided hair, horns, and intricate blue and gold armor levitates dramatically above a raging stormy sea at night, holding a glowing blue magical staff crackling with lightning in her right hand while her left hand summons a large swirling vortex of wind, water and energy, two old wooden sailing ships being tossed and wrecked by huge turbulent waves with white foam and glowing highlights, dark cloudy sky with lightning bolts and glowing blue and orange aurora borealis, ghostly white spectral figure swirling nearby, high detail fantasy scene
